articles.title: Indian Army chief arrives in Kathmandu for four-day visit
articles.summary: Indian Army Chief Dhiraj Seth has commenced a four-day visit to Kathmandu, Nepal, following a formal invitation from Nepal Army Chief Ashok Raj Sigdel. This high-level engagement between the defence chiefs is expected to strengthen military cooperation and bilateral ties between India and Nepal, facilitating discussions on regional security and strategic partnership.

articles.title: Dolphins news: Reacting and overreacting to preseason loss to Commanders
articles.summary: The Miami Dolphins opened their NFL preseason with a 20-7 loss against the Commanders. Despite the defeat, the Dolphins showcased some early highlights, particularly during the initial phases when their starting players were actively engaged, providing specific areas for the team to analyze and build upon for the upcoming regular season.

articles.title: GENERAL DHIRAJ SETH, CHIEF OF THE ARMY STAFF EMBARKS ON AN OFFICIAL VISIT TO NEPAL
articles.summary: General Dhiraj Seth, India's Chief of the Army Staff (COAS), commenced an official visit to Nepal from August 17, 2026. This high-level engagement aims to bolster bilateral defence cooperation and strengthen strategic ties between the Indian and Nepalese armies. Such visits are crucial for regional security discussions, enhancing interoperability, and fostering goodwill, reflecting India's proactive defence diplomacy with key neighbours.

articles.title: ‘Spearhead of annexation’: Israel hands West Bank rule to civilian police
articles.summary: Palestinian politicians and analysts are warning against an alleged Israeli plan to illegally annex the occupied West Bank. They claim Israel is implementing a series of decisions and actions to achieve this. This development exacerbates regional tensions and impacts international law regarding occupied territories, requiring diplomatic scrutiny and potential global response.

articles.title: YFN Spider-Man, Scrubs, Percy Jackson & More: BCTV Daily Dispatch
articles.summary: Today's BCTV Daily Dispatch reports on updates across popular streaming and television series, including 'Percy Jackson,' 'Scrubs,' 'Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man,' 'Lanterns,' 'Reacher,' and 'The X-Files.' This showcases the dynamic nature of digital entertainment and its pervasive cultural influence, driven by evolving media technologies and platforms.

articles.title: Russia hits steel plant in new strikes on Ukraine, Kyiv attacks Moscow region
articles.summary: Russia conducted a fresh wave of overnight airstrikes across Ukraine, causing two fatalities at a steel plant. Simultaneously, Kyiv launched a significant drone attack, signaling an escalation in hostilities. This ongoing tit-for-tat military action underscores the persistent geopolitical instability and the devastating human cost of the conflict, crucial for SSB aspirants to understand.
